note: FeatBenefit text: "You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons."

FeatBenefit text: "While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class." The brief's Defense entry names a `key: 'defense'` value; per controller ruling R19-adjacent guidance, `key` is dropped here (it is only the common optional effect-stacking key, not a semantic identifier, and this overlay does not need effect-stacking behavior). `when` is expressed with the armor-category predicate (light/medium/heavy) rather than a not-none predicate — both are logically equivalent since armorCategory() always returns exactly one category.

cite: SRD 5.2.1, Great Weapon Fighting (Fighting Style feat)
note: FeatBenefit text: "When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit." Our vocabulary's only mechanism is damage.rerollBelow (reroll, not treat-as-3) with value: 2, the closest declarative fit. AttackFilterSchema.property is a single slug and cannot express "Two-Handed OR Versatile", so no filter is emitted; both the weapon-class restriction and the exact treat-as-3 semantics need Phase-4 vocabulary.

FeatBenefit text: "When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren't already adding it to the damage." This needs off-hand/extra-attack context we don't model yet, so it is recorded as a feature.text stub only (no mechanical effect).
